name: vscode-uxml-preview
displayName: UXML Preview for Unity UI Toolkit
description: Render Unity UI Toolkit UXML/USS inside VS Code, without opening the Unity Editor.

commands.title: UXML Preview: Open Preview to the Side

uxmlPreview.canvas.width.description: Root element width in pixels. A fixed number by default: a canvas that follows the panel size makes the same file lay out differently for different people.

uxmlPreview.canvas.fitToPanel.description: Follow the preview panel size instead of the fixed width/height. Off by default on purpose — layouts with little slack flip on a few pixels of difference.

uxmlPreview.projectRoot.description: Unity project root used to resolve project:// paths and GUID references. Empty means the workspace folder containing the file.

uxmlPreview.states.description: Pseudo-class states keyed by USS selector, e.g. { "#SubmitButton": ["hover"] }. No UI in this version — see AGENTS.md, ponytail exception 1.

scripts.verify: npm run check:self-reference && npm run check:rules && npm run typecheck && npm run test
